prompt: High-fidelity desktop web app UI design mockup, landscape 1536x1024, of the Social page in "Monochrome", a self-hosted music streaming app shared by a small circle of friends. This is a usable product interface, not a poster, not a photograph of a screen, not a marketing site. Dark theme. App shell: near-black #0a0a0a window with rounded 14px charcoal blocks separated by 8px gutters. Left sidebar block 210px wide: tiny logo of two overlapping squares plus "Monochrome" wordmark, nav items Music, Library, Social (selected, subtle highlight), Listening stats; a "Recents" label with three small pill chips Playlists, Albums, Artists; Upload and Settings at the bottom. Bottom player bar block 76px tall across the full width: small cover thumbnail of Currents by Tame Impala, "Let It Happen" / "Tame Impala", shuffle, previous, play, next, repeat, thin progress bar 1:48 / 7:47, volume slider. The main content block fills the rest and holds the Social page. Clean neutral sans (Inter-like) for UI text. Real content only, spelled exactly as given. Visual world "The Booth" (same as the approved comp): the grammar of professional DJ deck displays translated into a social music page — matte black ground, members shown as circular album-cover jog-wheel discs inside dark platters with a thin progress ring in the cover color and a small white position marker near the rim, waveform overview strips tinted with the cover colors, square white cue brackets marking snippet ranges, condensed tabular numerals for times, a small green dot only for live members, soft diffuse glow of the cover colors spilling onto the black ground. Color comes only from album art; chrome is black, charcoal and white. No glassmorphism, no neon overload, no grid of cards. THIS FRAME SHOWS THE MESSAGES VIEW. Header row: "Social" title, green dot "2 listening · 3 online", quiet tabs Feed and Messages (active, underlined) with a small "2" badge. Directly under the header, the room collapses into a slim 64px strip: a single row of small 44px spinning cover discs with progress rings — Jon Bell (Midnight City, live), Luna (Breathe Deeper, live), then dimmer smaller discs admin, suiveurtag, Mara Vale, and avatar-only Noah, tester2, Inez Park — each with a tiny name under it. Below, the messages workspace fills the rest in one contained dark panel with two panes. LEFT PANE 300px, the conversation list as a deck "browse" screen: search field "Search" and a new-group icon; rows with 40px round avatar or group collage, bold name, one-line preview, tabular time on the right, a thin vertical white selection bar on the active row; each row carries a faint wash of the color of the last music shared in that conversation: "Luna — You: Snippet · Breathe Deeper — 9:41 PM" (active, orange-red wash), "Late Night Listeners — warm-up material — Aug 23" (group), "Noah — Snippet · Desire Be Desire Go — Aug 23", "dean withers — You: The Slow Rush — Aug 26", "kassav — Say hi with a track", "Pink — Say hi with a track". RIGHT PANE the thread with Luna: header with 36px avatar, name "Luna", status line with a mini equalizer "Listening to · Breathe Deeper", bell and info icons. The thread ground carries a very faint orange-red ambient glow from The Slow Rush cover in the top corner. Day label "TODAY" between hairlines. Messages: Luna (left, grey bubble) "hear this one?"; you (right, slightly lighter bubble) "the bridge at 2:10 is unreal" with small double-check ticks; Luna sends a snippet card shaped like a mini deck: 48px spinning cover disc of The Slow Rush, "Breathe Deeper — Tame Impala", play button, a horizontal waveform tinted orange and red with white square cue brackets around 2:04 – 2:34; you reply "ok that drop" with read ticks. Composer docked at the bottom as a slim control strip: image and music icons, text field "Message", round white send button with an arrow.
